title: Chain Singh Argues That the Panth Cannot Be Divided

blocks.text: The defeated side tries to explain away the reverse and imagine new combinations of power, but Chain Singh answers with political clarity rather than anger. Both Majhail and Malwai Singhs constituted a Singh fraternity, he insists, so no ruler will prosper by setting one section of the Panth against another.

He recommends negotiation through the full repertoire of statecraft rather than renewed adventurism. The familiar logic of Saam, Daam, Dand and Bhaid is invoked not to sanction treachery, but to restore balance after pride has already failed.

From this counsel comes a practical settlement. Occupied lands and revenues are restored, allied chiefs receive compensation, and the field victory is converted into a political acknowledgement of Khalsa solidarity.
